providers.name: Santa Maria Water Sports
providers.tagline: Private wakeboard & wakesurf boat charter in Malta
providers.description: Santa Maria Water Sports runs private boat charters from the Valletta Waterfront aboard a Nautique G25 — one of the world's finest performance wake boats. Whether you want to learn wakeboard, ride wakesurf, fly on a wakefoil, or simply cruise Malta's dramatic coastline, their certified instructors tailor every session to your level. Charters run from 1 hour to a full day and can reach any point along Malta's coast from the Grand Harbour.

discount.label: 5% off any charter booking
discount.instructions: Online: enter the code in the 'Add Coupon or Promotional Code' field before paying. By phone: mention the code when booking. Valid throughout 2026.

providers.name: Block Hotel
providers.tagline: 3-star hotel in the heart of Xlendi Bay, Gozo
providers.description: Block Hotel is a 3-star hotel in the heart of Xlendi Bay, Gozo — rooms, apartments and one Penthouse, right where the action is. This is a lively hotel. Guests come for the diving, stay for the rooftop, and end up at the bar. Xlendi Bay is on your doorstep — the Inland Sea, Fungus Rock and Dwejra are minutes away, and some of Europe's best dive sites are right below the building.

Cannot be combined with other offers.
